title: Compact onboarding slate: model selector tiles, request composer, and code-flows for Hosted API
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design assets for a compact onboarding slate used in Hosted API docs and the first-run experience. Includes model selector tile variants (compact, accessible), a small-screen request composer with example prompts and slots for structured output, and two code flow screenshots illustrating Node.js streaming and Python sync usage. Purpose: provide visual assets for docs, quickstart modal, and marketing one-pager while remaining optimized for mobile and low-bandwidth previews.
design_notes: Model tiles: emphasize model capability + cost per 1k tokens badge; include compact secondary label for 'latency profile' (Low/Med/High)
Composer: single-line compact prompt editor with dropdown for functions/tool-calling and a persistent example prompt button
Code flows: show minimal dependency imports and a short comment with expected latency and cost estimate
Accessibility: all contrast checks performed against WCAG AA; large tap targets for mobile; alt text strings included in annotations
Variant strategy: export 'full', 'compact', and 'annotated' PNGs so docs can use the variant that best fits layout
